description: Lowest nightly hotel prices for a city and stay dates from Google Hotels' public results page (about 18-20 hotels, Google's order): hotel name, 'prices starting from' amount, currency as Google shows it (it follows the server's region, so check the currency field) and Google's deal flag with % below usual. Confirms the dates Google applied. Not a booking; prices change constantly. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

checkout.description: Check-out date YYYY-MM-DD, after check-in, at most 30 nights (required)
